scope: First local practice battle: tactical console, one drone, pulse lance, shields/hull, shared bridge/exterior state and reset.

authority.source: Direct user chat following report round 20
authority.quote: Yep, that all sounds great. Let's do it.

safety_tests.scope: Temporary local fixtures and mock storage; no real transfers

checks.name: Walk to the tactical console and deploy a passive training drone through native controls
Target lock starts return fire; shield damage, pulse hits and effects come from the same encounter
Pause, settings and input focus freeze combat; bridge and exterior share damage and lock, and walking cannot fire
Held fire completes a winning battle; terminal state stops both guns
Shields absorb before hull; defeat disables the ship; practice reset restores both sides without teleporting
Repeated encounters reuse graphics resources; narrow layouts expose native lock and fire controls
Leaving weapon range blocks both guns without losing encounter state
Context recovery stays paused; reload clears practice while preserving voyage; assisted travel ends the encounter

checks.name: Enter a human-scale bridge with one canvas and a live forward world view
Click-to-look turns only the walker; Escape releases the cursor and pauses walking
Helm thrust and steering move the same ship; look and exterior view preserve command state
Walk through the passage, launch Peregrine, fly away and return aboard the original parked battleship
Walk back to command; repeated interior visits reuse geometry, textures and the renderer
Settings and quality choices preserve the visit; phone layouts expose walking and helm controls without overflow
Context restoration pauses safely; reload resumes the same battleship from exterior flight
Full horizontal orbit and above/below views leave the ship still; release returns around the hull
Left drag steers; right takes camera control during a chord and releases while left stays held
Pause, focus loss and cancelled pointer input clear camera control
Inspection shuttle can look around without moving the shuttle or parked battleship
Camera orbit preserves arrival assist and surface heading and altitude
Reduced motion returns directly to chase view
Native capture requests raw input and normal mouse movement keeps its expected sensitivity
Injected spikes in either direction are discarded without losing the good axis or moving the view later
Walking alone preserves pitch; Escape and recapture preserve look without a stale drag jump
Native drag look remains smooth; a discontinuous drag sample rebases without a pitch snap
Unsupported raw input falls back to native capture; denied capture retains drag controls

checks.name: One persistent canvas; the three existing shuttle selections work
Right-drag moves the camera without steering; browser menus remain available on UI
Keyboard thrust, climb, descent, turn, pitch, strafe, and mouse steering
Pause and controls overlay prevent flight; Escape closes controls
Settings persist; form input does not fly the ship
Orbit assist, shuttle excursion, surface controls, and carrier return
Manual boosted flight crosses a sector boundary without an edge
Travel crosses sectors, loaded worlds stay bounded, reload restores voyage and preferences
Phone layouts fit; pointer flight control releases without sticking

Unavailable graphics shows a readable fallback and disables flight

rendered_review.method: Viewed final PNG captures after final combat rerun
rendered_review.findings: Tactical controls, world-visible pulse and shield effects, shared damage and narrow control layout inspected. Prototype art remains.

resolved_attempts: Node strip-only loader rejected a constructor parameter property. Replaced it with an explicit field and cloned assignment; all model tests passed.
Initial browser attempt could not match the Start practice button because its icon entered the accessible name. Marked the decorative icon aria-hidden; full combat suite passed.

knowledge_lookup.projectile: First page: ten passages from four distinct Unreal-oriented sources. No applicable implementation reused; further pages not read.
knowledge_lookup.threejs_combat: Quoted Three.js plus combat returned no selected-catalog result; complete_for_scope true, next_cursor null. This is not evidence that no external knowledge exists.

limits: Stationary drone; instantaneous pulse hits, not projectile ballistics or pursuit AI.
Temporary training damage; no persistent ship damage, physical destruction, crew combat, general enemy tactics or multiplayer.
Native installed Chrome 157.0.8103.78 on this RTX 5090 desktop. Narrow desktop views do not establish phone GPU, thermal or power performance.
Physical phones/laptops, other browser engines, Electron runtime, long play, fresh agent-session loading and real generation capture remain untested.
Dedicated battleship/quality, long terrain and fallback-depth suites were not rerun this turn; prior receipts remain historical.
No commit, push, website deployment, asset transfer, paid generation or research submission.

report.observed: Resolute takes fire; Round 21; Nothing waits on you
